descriptionWindows: Strip down Windows — remove telemetry, bloatware, and unnecessary services
descriptionOther: Harden your system — manage privacy settings and unnecessary services

privacy.pageDescription: Control telemetry, ads, tracking, and data collection across your system
privacy.emptyStateDescription: Click "Scan" to audit your privacy and security settings and apply recommended hardening.
privacy.adminWarning: Some settings require administrator privileges to modify. Run DiNho Optimizer as administrator for full protection.
privacy.ipcCallFailed: IPC call failed — try running as administrator

descriptions.telemetry-level: Set diagnostic data collection to minimum (Security level only)
descriptions.activity-history: Stop Windows from tracking and syncing your app and file usage
descriptions.publish-activity: Prevent Windows from publishing your activities to Microsoft
descriptions.feedback-frequency: Disable periodic Microsoft feedback prompts and surveys
descriptions.handwriting-telemetry: Stop sending handwriting and typing data to Microsoft
descriptions.input-personalization: Disable typing and inking personalization data collection
descriptions.tailored-experiences: Stop Microsoft from using diagnostic data to personalize tips and ads
descriptions.app-launch-tracking: Stop Windows from tracking which apps you open to 'improve' Start menu
descriptions.advertising-id: Disable the unique advertising ID that apps use to track you
descriptions.suggested-content: Block Microsoft from showing app suggestions and ads in Settings
descriptions.tips-notifications: Disable Windows tips, tricks, and suggestion notifications
descriptions.start-suggestions: Disable app suggestions (ads) in the Start menu
descriptions.lock-screen-spotlight: Disable Microsoft Spotlight ads and suggestions on the lock screen
descriptions.silently-installed-apps: Prevent Windows from automatically installing promoted apps
descriptions.preinstalled-apps: Stop Windows from suggesting pre-installed apps you haven't used
descriptions.bing-start-menu: Stop search queries from being sent to Bing via Start menu
descriptions.bing-web-search: Disable web results in Windows Search — keep searches local only
descriptions.cortana: Disable Cortana — stops background resource usage and data collection
descriptions.search-highlights: Disable trending search suggestions and web content in search box
descriptions.store-search-suggestions: Disable Microsoft Store search suggestions that send queries to Microsoft
descriptions.clipboard-sync: Prevent clipboard data from being synced across devices via the cloud
descriptions.clipboard-history: Disable clipboard history that stores copied text and images
descriptions.settings-sync: Stop syncing Windows settings, themes, and passwords to your Microsoft account
descriptions.find-my-device: Disable location-based device tracking by Microsoft
descriptions.copilot: Disable Microsoft Copilot AI assistant across Windows
descriptions.windows-recall: Disable Windows Recall AI screenshot history that captures everything on screen
descriptions.click-to-do: Disable Click To Do AI text and image analysis on screen content
descriptions.ai-service-autostart: Prevent AI services from automatically starting in the background
descriptions.edge-ai-features: Disable Edge AI text composition and rewriting features
descriptions.paint-ai: Disable AI image generation features in Microsoft Paint
descriptions.notepad-ai: Disable AI text rewriting features in Microsoft Notepad
descriptions.recall-blocker: Blocks Windows AI Recall from saving snapshots of your screen
descriptions.service-diagtrack: Disable Connected User Experiences and Telemetry service — not recommended for FiveM/Minecraft
descriptions.service-dmwappush: Disable WAP Push Message routing service used for telemetry
descriptions.service-delivery-optimization: Disable Windows Update P2P sharing — stops your PC from uploading update data to other devices
descriptions.service-mapsbroker: Disable Downloaded Maps Manager — unnecessary background service
descriptions.task-compatibility-appraiser: Disable Microsoft telemetry collector for compatibility data
descriptions.task-program-data-updater: Disable background program telemetry upload task
descriptions.task-autochk-proxy: Disable telemetry data collection via autochk proxy
descriptions.task-ceip-consolidator: Disable Customer Experience Improvement Program data upload
descriptions.task-usb-ceip: Disable USB device usage telemetry collection
descriptions.task-disk-diagnostic: Disable disk diagnostic data collection and upload
descriptions.task-feedback-dm: Disable feedback device management telemetry task
descriptions.task-maps-update: Disable automatic map data downloads in the background
descriptions.edge-metrics: Stop Edge from sending usage and crash metrics to Microsoft
descriptions.edge-site-info: Stop Edge from sending site URLs to Microsoft to improve services
descriptions.edge-personalization: Stop Edge from sending browsing history for ad personalization
descriptions.edge-copilot-cdp: Prevent Copilot from reading your page content via Chrome DevTools Protocol
descriptions.edge-copilot-page: Prevent Copilot from accessing page context for content analysis
descriptions.edge-discover: Stop the Discover feature from scanning page content
descriptions.edge-sidebar: Disable the Edge sidebar and its background data collection
descriptions.edge-shopping: Disable the shopping price comparison tracker in Edge
descriptions.chrome-metrics: Stop Chrome from sending usage and crash metrics to Google
descriptions.chrome-feedback: Prevent Chrome from collecting and sending user feedback data
descriptions.chrome-extended-reporting: Stop Chrome from sending extended URL and download reports to Google
descriptions.firefox-telemetry: Disable Firefox telemetry data collection and upload to Mozilla
descriptions.firefox-default-agent: Disable the background agent that reports browser usage data to Mozilla

privacyCategories.telemetryDescription: Control diagnostic and usage data collection
privacyCategories.adsDescription: Block promoted apps, ad suggestions, and lock screen spotlight
privacyCategories.searchDescription: Keep searches local and disable web-based search features
privacyCategories.syncDescription: Control clipboard syncing, settings sync, and device tracking
privacyCategories.servicesDescription: Disable background services that collect and upload telemetry
privacyCategories.tasksDescription: Disable telemetry scheduled tasks running in the background
privacyCategories.kernelDescription: Kernel security parameters and memory protection via sysctl
privacyCategories.networkDescription: Network stack hardening and traffic filtering via sysctl
privacyCategories.accessDescription: Access control policies, SSH hardening, and system restrictions
privacyCategories.aiDescription: Disable Copilot, Recall, and other AI features that analyze your data
privacyCategories.recallDescription: Block Windows AI Recall from capturing screen snapshots
privacyCategories.browserDescription: Stop browsers from reporting usage data to Microsoft, Google, and Mozilla

debloater.pageDescription: Remove pre-installed Windows apps and OEM bloatware
debloater.irreversibleWarning: Irreversible — Removed apps can only be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store. Review selections carefully.
debloater.emptyStateDescription: Click "Scan" to find pre-installed apps and OEM bloatware.
debloater.confirmDescription: This will permanently remove {{count}} app(s). They can be reinstalled from the Microsoft Store if needed.
debloater.scanFailedError: Failed to scan for bloatware. Make sure PowerShell is available.
debloater.removeFailedError: Failed to remove some apps. Administrator privileges may be required.

serviceManager.pageDescription: View, manage, and disable unnecessary Windows services to improve performance
serviceManager.infoBannerUseRecommended: Use "Apply Recommended" for a safe one-click preset.
serviceManager.emptyStateDescription: Enumerate all services and identify which ones can be safely disabled to improve performance.
serviceManager.confirmDescription: This will disable {{count}} service(s) and stop any that are currently running. This requires administrator privileges.
serviceManager.confirmEnableDescription: This will enable {{count}} service(s) — startup type will be restored to original or set to Manual.
